slides.text:
5 signs your soul is waking up

(and why it feels so lonely at first)

1. The noise gets louder

Things you used to scroll past now feel loud. The news. The gossip. The endless urgency.

You're not getting sensitive. You're getting honest.

2. Small talk feels empty

You still love the people around you.

You just can't talk about nothing anymore.

3. You question everything

The food. The 9 to 5. The "that's just how it is."

Not to be difficult. Because something in you knows there's more.

4. You notice the signs

The right book at the right time. The right person. The same numbers again and again.

You start seeing what was always there.

5. You crave real over easy

Real food. Real sleep. Real people. Real silence.

The fake stuff starts tasting like plastic.

If 3 or more of these felt familiar,

you're not lost.

You're waking up.

Follow @jac_lavoiee. We're finding each other.
